Frequently Asked Questions

Rooms & Accommodation FAQ

What room types are available at Radiant Vista?

Radiant Vista has three room types: the Classic Room, the Premium Room and the Suite. All rooms have individually controlled air conditioning, a 42-inch Smart TV and high-speed Wi-Fi. The Suite adds a separate lounge, which is useful for families and guests who need to meet in private.

What amenities are included in every room?

Every room has individually controlled air conditioning, a 42-inch Smart TV, a hot water kettle, high-speed Wi-Fi and a work desk, and the whole building is CCTV-secured. Premium Rooms and Suites also include a mini fridge and a safe deposit locker for your valuables.

What are the check-in and check-out times?

Check-in and check-out times are confirmed with your booking. If you are arriving early or leaving late, tell the reservations team when you book. Call or WhatsApp +91 91871 95517 and they will confirm what is possible for your dates.

What ID do I need at check-in?

Please bring a valid government-issued photo ID for every adult guest, such as an Aadhaar card, passport, driving licence or voter ID. Foreign nationals need a passport and visa. If you are unsure whether a document will be accepted, ask reservations on +91 91871 95517 before you travel.

Is parking available at the hotel?

Yes. Radiant Vista has secure basement parking for guests, and the premises are monitored by CCTV around the clock. If you are coming with several cars for an event or a group booking, let the front desk know in advance so the team can plan parking for you.

Can I get a GST invoice for a corporate stay?

If you need a GST invoice for a business stay, tell the reservations team when you book and share your company name, billing address and GSTIN. Call or WhatsApp +91 91871 95517, or email reservations@hotelradiantvista.com, so the details are on file before you check in.

How do I book a room at Radiant Vista?

The quickest way is our online booking engine, which shows live availability and rates. You can also call or WhatsApp reservations on +91 91871 95517, call the front desk on +91 836 200 2487, or email reservations@hotelradiantvista.com. The team can help with group, corporate and long-stay bookings.
